title: IPC send params
description:
Parameters of a directed send over local IPC: remote destination and payload, and nothing else.

THE ABSENCE IS THE POINT. There is no `source_endpoint` parameter, and `additionalProperties: false` is what makes that enforceable rather than merely stated: the runtime derives the source from the caller's active lease, so a client cannot claim to be another local endpoint by adding a field. That is the one place ADR-0030's non-spoofable source is decided, and a schema that accepted unknown properties would quietly re-open it.

A client holding no lease receives EndpointNotRegistered — it cannot send at all, rather than sending as nobody.

endpoint.description: The REMOTE destination endpoint. Omitted asks the remote profile for its configured default endpoint — never fan-out (ADR-0030).

media_type.description: 1..128 ASCII bytes when present. Empty is INVALID rather than an alias for absence — the content fingerprint distinguishes the two, so collapsing them would make two different messages share a dedup identity.

bytes.description: Unpadded base64url. maxLength 65536 encoded characters is the 48 KiB (49,152-byte) payload ceiling of ADR-0026 — the number the 128 KiB frame ceiling exists to accommodate. The pattern asserts both the alphabet and the legal terminal lengths, since `contentEncoding` is an annotation in Draft 2020-12 and constrains nothing on its own.
